data.title: Unify the report catalogue under kadence report
data.description: Discovery 2026-09-15: burndown lives under sprint, workload and group-by under stats, milestone progress under milestone. An agent reading schema --json cannot discover the burndown, so 'kadence report' is not the catalogue it looks like. Add report burndown, report velocity, report workload as thin aliases onto the existing folds, plus report --list. Zero new computation. Every alias then gets --html for free. Detail in docs/research/reports-discovery-2026-09.md, addendum.
